fullPassage: Even outdoors, although climate (including temperature) is usually regarded as beyond the control of man, localized temperature control is sometimes effective on a microclimate scale. Vancouver, Canada, is a few miles north of the 49th parallel, about 60 miles farther north than Minot, North Dakota, with its legendary harsh winter temperatures. But constant foehn winds off the Pacific Ocean make Vancouver winters mild and wet, although sunshine is scant. When I had a garden there in the late 1940s, a neighbor used to say that I "cheated God" to bring in my lettuce and tomatoes earlier than anyone else. The bed in which the vegetables grew was banked toward the south at approximately 50 degrees, and the area between the plants was covered with flat stones, gathered from the nearby beach, to maximize soil heating from the weak late winter–early spring sun.

❌ ② farther north(더 북쪽)인데 남쪽이라고 함
✅ ③ 푄 바람 — 일치
✅ ④ 돌로 가열 극대화 — 일치
det.tip: 방향 정보 주의: farther north = 더 북쪽

questions.passage: Even outdoors, although climate (including temperature) is usually regarded as beyond the control of man, localized temperature control is sometimes effective on a microclimate scale. Vancouver, Canada, is a few miles north of the 49th parallel, about 60 miles farther north than Minot, North Dakota, with its legendary harsh winter temperatures. But constant foehn winds off the Pacific Ocean make Vancouver winters mild and wet, although sunshine is scant. When I had a garden there in the late 1940s, a neighbor used to say that I "cheated God" to bring in my lettuce and tomatoes earlier than anyone else. The bed in which the vegetables grew was banked toward the south at approximately 50 degrees, and the area between the plants was covered with flat stones, gathered from the nearby beach, to maximize soil heating from the weak late winter–early spring sun.
questions.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 야외에서도 미기후 규모의 국지적 온도 제어가 가능하다는 것이 핵심입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 미기후 규모의 온도 제어 가능성 — 핵심 주제
❌ ① 밴쿠버의 관광 명소 — 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ 채소 재배의 경제적 이점 — 부수적 내용
❌ ④ 기후 변화의 원인 — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: 첫 문장이 주제문: localized temperature control is sometimes effective
